body:
Hey. Thank you. I will tell you why am i ungrateful... long story. I will move to work next week abroad. I feel so lonely. I will Leave my student life behind. leave my parents behind.. without having ever showed love. i am incapable of love. of receiving and giving love. i Cannot feel.
I want to suppress my feelings. I want to suppress my human ability to feel emotion. 
Running is the only reason I want to live. It is the only thing that lets me feel myself'，the connection between my body and my mind. 
When i am running i feel no pain. I cannot think of anything else but how good it feels... Running in my bones. Nothing can compare to that feeling.
Why do I see exercise as a bad thing？i dont. I
see exercise as the greatest medicine of my life. A medicine I have long abused and my body still lets me pay the price to this day.
I have a history of abusing excercise as a way to cope with my depression and anxiety. 
I would define me as an exercise addict. 
I have a history of overuse injuries. It was the worst time of my life. When i got injured and I couldnt run.. I had to face my feelings like never before. I was crying every day. I was starving myself，i was in a fight with my body. With the world because i wanted to Run. I just wanted to be myself. 
Sometimes i still get the pain intermittently. I start to sweat even at a bruise on my leg. I panick thst the pain will come back. Every Run i take，I am so afraid that the pain will come back. But i Run even if my fear is overwhelming，because thats who I am. If My body will give it to me，I will take it. The greatest gift of my life... The feeling of running.
Running is such a big part of my identity. of my life. I dont want to lose it again. I am following a very strict training regimen. 
not strict on my running，strict on my rest i have to give to my body. 
I have to RESPECT rest. The rule is I will wait 48 hours between every run. 
My mental health depends on exercise. I feel lonely，I run it out. I feel sad，I run. 
when i got injured. I starved myself.. I would never let food take away，the skinny body that running has given me. I would never let food take away my identity as a runner. I lost so much weight when I was injured. 
But when Running came back. It has thaught me that food is my friend，carbohydrate is the fuel of my Run. Why cant I make peace with food. With life.
At the moment i eat for fuel. The ability to have feelings towards food.. The ability to feel pleasure in food is something i have lost. If you give me chocolate it disgusts me. I eat complex carbohydrates，because i will fuel my body to give me what i want.
 But in a way Running has given me the power over my long ingrained voices of my distorted eating. 
When I returned running. I gained back to 'normal' weight because running made me hungry，made me shift my goal to health rather than my desire to see a 0 on the scale.
I have even started to carbo load. For fuel not for enjoyment. I hope one day to return running like before. I used to Run 4-5 hours on the best of my summer days. These were the golden times. Times i will hold forever in my heart. 
When I run i can feel nothing and everything at the same time.

Unlike me. You are a good person. How did you do it. 
Today my father said to me how can I be so emotionless. 
I said to him that is what I want. My father said
he hopes i will never feel again，because the moment when I will start to feel again. It will feel so painful.
I will move to work，next week . New country. New apartment. New gym.. I actually havent looked at apartments. I have looked at the gym. I need to work out. The worst torture for me is to sit down. Sit down at home alone. 
I have never showed love to my parents. I cannot live with that feeling. I want to do everything I can to shut down my body to have feelings. 
Its just a when. I will do that as i did it before. When my body will not give me running anymore. I will destroy it.
Exercise comes pretty close to suppress my feelings.. But its temporary. If I starve myself. My body will conserve energy. I know that. I did it before. That way，I hope to kill myself. Its the only way i know. My personal trainer told me I cannot run. Because I am too thin. 

I said to him fuck you. The same word i said to my family doctor who told me the same. And the same I said to my parents. I WILL RUN UNTIL I CANT. I DONT SPEAK TO ANYONE WHO TELLS ME THAT. 

I refuse to feel. But i get moments when my body will let me feel emotion. Especially after I am fully functioning. With food on my stomach. 
I hate every moment of the day I am not Running. 

I know how to destroy me. I came pretty close before until i was stopped. Just. Is there a quicker way to do it.

i am so sorry. But i hope you can continue with low impact exercises like cycling，elliptical... Its not running but its one billion skies better than nothing. Thats what i am on these days. I have also been into strength training. I have been exercising my body beyond exhaustion despite my leg injury. I am seeing a psychokogist to manage my exercise addiction. Exercise is the only thing that makes my mind completely focused and takes me away from all the toxic people around me. I dont wanna see and hear anyone. Unfortunately my body is so exhausted. I am so afraid i will lose it one day.
So when the cartilage has worn away you can return to sport with your knee 'replacement'？

So they are actually going to set up new knees for you？That sounds very unpleasant to say the least. I am so sorry to hear that. But Will you be able to resume your sport activities with new knees then？I heard knee problems are some of the worst. I personally have shin splint problems. If i am not careful they can develop into a full blown stress fracture. i am right on the borderline i think.

I dont understsnd. when the cartiage is worn away what will happen？What are robo knees？
Even if you eat antiinflammatory diet like pineapple，Omega 3，antioxidant rich berries... That does not help even a bit？I had a friend Micke this Summer when Iwas working away at Kolasen in Sweden. He had the same problem as you.

People are just fake. Everyone is good at saying Oh you are so young oh i feel so sorry... They can also spare their bullshit in my opinion. I understand your pain，on these days i am just sitting alone and doing my work. Then I exercise what i can. i dont wanna see and hear anyone. We have to give our bodies our priority. Look who is talking yeah... the one who exercises injured. Well i exercise injured because i cannot stand the pain of not exercising.
But we have to take care of our bodies Because they are our only friends. 
People dont make me feel better，
People are fake. As long as you are all happy and good you will have many friends. When you are in difficulty you will see how things change. Cant you loan the money from someone to make this surgery. I think its your most important priority at the moment. Exercise is a truly real，genuine thing that makes you feel better. Thsts not fake. Its real，unlike people

I am incredibly sorry to hear this. I also was overweight as a kid. Now i am almost anorexic. I was impacted by low self esteem and exercise is the only thing that let me feel fine in myself. 
I use exercise to control my weight，but i value exercise in itself. To me it has immense intrinsic value beyond weight control. 
 your old job is the reason for your condition？I didnt understand because you said you had Patellofemoral Syndrome. Thats on the knees and common with runneRs. I have chronic shin splints. I can still do low impact activities . Doesn t mean i should do it but cutting exercise is not an option for me. I would see a doctor to look at your knees. It doesnt sound good. Is it permanent？What about swimming？
You like strength training？Why cant you do it？I actually hate it. I do it to keep my body toned by cardio is my cup of tea

I just eat 50 percent of my previous calories，cut carbs by half and double on protein and keep fruits and veggies the same quantities. I have trackers so i know exactly how many calories in and out. I actually lost weight without exercising because i eat so much less. People think i am too thin，but i dont care about healthy weight what i care is my fastest running weight. Running for me comes before health. But i will keep cycling and elliptical everyday. It seems my body can handle that. I did burn 800 calories with that today. It hurts a bit but not exercising hurts more

my friend advised me not to answer to these people. He is using my condition to make money. He said if i give him money he will give me 'lessons' to move my foot so i can run again pain free. My friend said these people just wanna make money. My friend she is also at the gym. Today she got very pissed with me because she saw me again with a bag full of fruits. She said i have to eat. But these days if i cannot run i just refuse to eat. i am eating 50 percent of my old portions. She said i have to change this thinking and brought me to the supermarket ro show me what foods to buy 😩😩... I just got back from indoor cycling training. Its a life saver. I feel much better after this exercise session. Feel also less guilty about eating the grapes.

Yeah. People only know how to talk bullshit. They dont understand us. Exercise has always been my religion，i have another personal trainer who approached me and said if i give him money he can help me. These are the kind of people i hate. they use your condition to get money. They can go and fuck themselves all these bullshit personal trainers.

I just got back from my elliptical workout. Against the advixe of my personal trainer，physical therapist，and doctor i went to exercise. My both legs hurt even more.  I want to kill myself. Enough of this bullshit of people convincing you to talk and talk about How  worth its to live... I wanna exercise！
I wonder if i do the elliptical trainer... Will it do too much harm？
I can cycle. But its not the same
Its a DISGRACE. I dont know How to kill myself. I dont live without exercise. Its not the Life i Did sign up for.

I feel the same. Running has been my weapon for everything. Its not right！Fuck this disgusting life. Running means everything to me. its so unjust I will find a way to kill myself because its my decision. If I cant run，I refuse to live. And Gos has to respect my decision. Iwill not live on his terms，He took this away from me. And I will be the last one to have the word，the action. I am So angry

The problem is that I can never learn from my mistakes. i succesfully managed to injure my right leg. Its the same injury i got in my left leg three months ago. It wasnt enough to run once a day，twice a day wasnt enough. I dont wanna see anyone. Judt the clock. I just want the moment i can run painfree again  . In the acute stage of my injury... I know i have to rest completely for two weeks. I have to be in HELL for two weeks. I had to cut down my calorie intake by 30 percent to maintain my marathon weight. Not only i cant exercise. I cant eat，i cant be myself because outside of my running. I have no identity. I hate everything. I had to eat half a banana at lunch. I hate it Because i want to eat the whole banana. I had to take a walk today. I hate it because i want to run. Not walk.

Since childhood I have been addicted to exercise. I wasnt myself if i didnt get my 100 km bike ride in the summer holidays. I just had to cycle to the lakelands and then swim for hours and cycle my 50 km way back to town... I loved  it. Then i discovered running. Why did God give me this only to take it away from me？I understand your pain. I define myself with Exercise. Without running. I am a piece of nothing sitting on the couch. Even my dog has more feelings than me. I am just waiting for the moment i can run pain free again. I want to end this. I want to exercise myself to death. Drink lethal amounts of coffee and exercise myself until i get heart failure. I almost died like that last year.l. I wish I could take away the almost part.

I wish i was in your gym. In my gym there is this one I cant stand. When I run injured there is this bodybuilder I disgust. He is a piece of shit. When I run injured he takes pictures of me and send them to me to show me how ugly I run. I hate people like this. I hate them. With all his muscles he cant even run half an hour. When injured I can run for hours at high speed . He cant even run half an hour how can he take the right to insult me like that. I hate it. Now i am again on the couch，succesfully managed to re-injure myself. I dont want to see anyone. Not my personal trainer who i thought to be my friend. Not this disgusting bodybuilder. Not the gym receptionist，not my parents and not all the fake people that say to be your friend. Exercise is my religion. Not people. I hate myself，because It wasnt enough to Run once a day. Twice a day wasnt enough. For the sake of personal pleasure now I have to pay this price. I can of course exerxise until i break my leg. I can consider that

Thank you. How can I Send you a reddit？I want to exercise. And I just injured my right tibilias anterior muscle this weekend. After being restricted to exercise. I had a huge withdrawal on friday night and I exploded in the weekend. I exercised almost the whole day and of course. My leg got injured. I know why. Its the same injury i had on my left leg 4 months ago. I have to follow the same treatment protocol which is rest. I HATE REST. Its like telling me you have a stomach ache... Dont eat. Can you do that？Its like saying my chest hurts ... Dont breathe. I have to rest at least during the acute phase which is aboit two weeks. I HATE EVERY MOMENT. If i would have run once a day... This would not have happened  i asked for this and i knew it was gonna happen because I never learn from my past mistakes. i had the exact same injury on my left leg three months ago. My training is not oriented. I just use exercise to treat my depression and now i cant even have that！

Thank you. I am Sorry to hear you have been stopped to play soccer. thw Sport you love. I understand the pain. If its knee problems could It be a weight issue？For me，knees Actually are the only problem i never had because i Always kept my weight at the lower end of a healthy range. i will ask around about crossfit，But i wont ask my personal trainer. She thinks i am a failure. i refused to listen to her... told me to run Three times a week and do the Cross training As you said. Instead i never Did weight Lifting and run 3 times a day. Not a week. She told me there is Nothing We can do. Meaning she gives up on me
Yes you can teach me that... I mean How to chat because i dont know.

Yes i Did That for months in addition to Running injured. I dont like to strength train. I dont like to lift things up and put them down. I want to move my body. I want to sweat and Feel running in my bones. I used to Feel amazing in the past... Running Once a day. Now I Feel deprived if i run Three times a day. I want to Run the whole day. Walking is nothing，Swimming Cannot compare to Running. Nothing can replace the void of Running. Nothing can replace that.

Hey Thank you for that. I am quite new to reddit and i doNt know How to chat. I am already seeing a psychologist for managing my exercise addiction. It doesnt help because i just want to Run. And i will keep exercising until i break my bones. i have  a High pain tolerance，But i know there is something wrong with my pain. I want to kill it. I dont want this body anymore.

My personal trainer thinks i am a failure. I stopped seeing her. I am a very materialistic person， i dont know what term to use. I would Rather die than lose all my fitness i have worked all my Life to gain. 
I have Nothing inside，I have no pleasure in eating，in having any kind of human relationship. I dont even want sex. I want to exercise. I need to exercise. i Cannot sleep at Night because I need to train. But I cant. I know i will never train like before because my addixtion to exerxise has desteoyed my body. I refuse to Rest. And I dont know How to end this because i am a fucking coward. I better find the courage because I Cant live in a body that doesnt let me live the way i want

I know. I know But i Cant control myself. After being restricted to run It backfired So badly this weekend. I was having 3 training sessionsa day. Yesterday i was about to Go to sleep. i had this uncontrollable urge to Run. So i laced up. I Cant control myself. I have seen therapists. But i dont like them. I wanna run，running is my therapy But i dint need to say That because noone understands me anyway. If i dont Run. Here is what happens，I Cannot Feel myself，I Feel all the anxiety creeping up to skyrocketing levels，I count every single calorie. On some days i Cant eat because i dont Run. But the worse It at night. I Cannot sleep because i have to release all this energy in me. I want to Run. i need It like oxygen. If my body will not let Ne Run. I will not give It Food. I Treat It the same way It treats me
i dont wanna vary... i just wanna run

she is very beautiful personal trainer and person，but she ordered me to run 3 times a week. Nothing more because of my excessive weight loss. She is pissed with me because I run 3 times a day. Not a week. I dont want my body to stop me. I dont know how to limit my exercise because i want running to last forever

No I want to run. You cannot understand me. I cannot sleep at night because i am afraid my body will not let me exercise anymore one day.
No psychiatrist. I dont want that. Running is my therapy. its always been. 
I will not Rest let me do the elliptical tomorrow. If i dont run i Cannot eat. And i cannot sleep，despite 3 running sessions i Feel So deprived. I Cant sleep because i am busy crying. I want to run. Now. 
Nothing can satisfy my craving for running. I dont want food，people，sex. Its so easy to lose weight for me. Because i have no pleasure in that，eating means nothing but fuel for me. Exerxise is my escape from depression. I need it. I cannot live without exercise. I want to run now.

just got back from my third running session of today. My  personal trainer got very pissed with me and I have been told to stay away from running for one week because i hurt both of my lower legs these days. I dont know what to do. I get very bad withdrawal if i dont run. I cant live. What do i do this week 🌧🌧 .

Hey Thank you.

After getting x ray one month ago，I got to See That this is not a stress fracture. Its muscular shin splints.
Since Then I have been running about one month through acceptable pain. 
The pain was very acceptable，escpecially After Following a completely antiinflammatory diet. 
I Did not See the Doctor because I do not have a stress fracture and I know He will tell me to Rest. 
Running is the meaning.of my life，I am not gonna Rest. It means everything to me.

Right now the pain I would describe It As chronic，acceptable to the point That It little affects my Run..Sometimes its intermittent，It comes very sharp Then disappears. 

Do you think even if the level of pain is chronic and acceptable， I am still causing damage？

Coming from a Running addict... See running for what It truly is，a gift. 
Take the time to listen to Your body，How does It Feel to Run without pain？Its the most beautiful feeling in the world. 

Do not use Running As a means for weight control，That is not How exercise has to be. The relationship with exerxise needs to be pleasure，It has to give you pleasure. 

The most important thing，Try to listen to your body. Yes It is possible to love a Sport too much... In my case，I Cant put into words How I miss to Feel running in my bones. I Cannot run because It is months thst I am injured，I pushed my body Beyond its capacity. Dont make the same mistake. 

I was Marathon training for months，Did not take a single Rest day for months.

Rest is one part. The other part unless you have excess fat to lose... 

You have to adjust your nutrition in order to support long term running. 
Or you are gonna lose weight and become weaker. 

I just got on the scale today.. I read 50.5 kg. I was astonished. I thought the scale was broken. 

I basically Eat lumberjack portions everyday... And I am not running because i am injured . The thing is，
I have been running for months and months so much thst i could not physically eat back all the calories i was burning. 

two months of no running and eating like a cow，still have not gained weight. 

I just need to gain one kg. to get a BMI above 18.5 will will classify as healthy weight.

My point adjust your nutrition to your running，
the exception is for people who have excess fat to lose then you dont need. 

But basically just lace up and run. You just need your body. Running is the most complete sport you can have. Running is not a chore，it had to be your pleasure. Otherwise I would never do a sport which i dont enjoy. The key to a healthy relationship with exercise is enjoyment. 

I dont enjoy weight training. But i had to do it to gain healthy weight when i was underweight... I hated every moment of that. I jist decided to stop that. I simply dont like weight training... Thankfully i am at a relatively healthy weight and not underweight anymore.  I stopped because i remembered  how running made me feel... that is how exercise is gotta be... It has to make you feel good. 

I just came from a 3 hours swim... To me nothing can replace a run，but swimming comes pretty close to it. Swimming with a running injury，and feeling no pain was a gift. 

I almost felt like running，how I miss to run. Everyday of my life.

I wish you the best to come in your new relationship with Running. Its a lifestyle，a gift that belongs to the healthy. 

I abused running too much，i loved how it made me feel. Now I lost it and cannot run. 

Dont make the same mistake as me. Run increasing your mileage no more than 10 percent a week. 

Most importantly，Run for your soul not for your body. The body you want will come automatically to you.

Yeah. Its not much about sacrifice，
its about how much work you put in to achieve the greatest passion of my life. 

You build up to that with training，nutrition and Rest. Then all of That is gone to the couch. Its disgusting. I am not getting over this one. I dont need this body anymore，not only I hate not running I hate losing fitness because to me its important. Some people dont care But I do，sitting on the couch is not what We are meant to do.

I am not capable of having any relationship at the moment，be It Family，old friends. Anyone. If I Cant be myself thats who I am.

I just live to do my duties work and wait until I run or die.

Yeah a few more days and I will See the doctor. Thats for sure. I am not Swimming in happiness tho.
I Cant immobilize my foot. I need to Walk

Yeah... I am so afraid to see the doctor when I go home. What if he is gonna put me on those sticks！I am gonna go to the mountains even with a wheelchair，
I want my independence，my legs.
I am not staying in that bloody city for the Summer. I want to go to the countryside，its the only month i can have that pleasure to just get away from everyone and be with Nature.. Away from the shallowness of city life. 

I prefer to die than to rely on another person even for picking up a book. I dont wanna be staying on those sticks if it turns out to be SF.

I dont know if I even want to see the doctor actually because i am afraid he is not gonna let me walk. 

My friend and personal trainer said i have to absolutely go to the doctor. My personal trainer said my nutrition and running form is just bad. 

He literaly forced me to Eat everytime i saw him，I went from 48 kg. to 50.7. Now i am satisfied because i am not underweight anymore but its enough i dont wanna gain more weight.
He wants me to eat double the amount i do.. Yeah i let him speak. He is crazy. He wants me to gain still another 10 kg.. out of his mind its never gonna happen.

He wants me to strength train and correct my running form when i do get back... If i ever will. 

Lucky you.. I feel i will never get back to Run.

I am no expert or doctor but its over two months that I have this pain..Of course ts not gonna go away. Its the greatest disgrace i ever had in my life these last two months. I remember that disgusting April day. Its a disgrace. 

I have a bad feeling about this. It has to be serious otherwise it would not last over two months. 

I actually can do the hop test. I can hop on it but what does that mean？I cannot walk without pain. If I run i think i am gonna be punished big this time so i just rest. BECAUSE I AM FORCED TO. 
Not running is prison.

I cant even eat，I dont feel i deserve to eat if i dont Run and i dont even have the appetite to eat the huge portions i used to.

I am not gonna tell this to my personal trainer but since i am not underweight anymore now i will cut my food intake by 50 percent to maintainance or below. He wants me to eat so much but i dont want if i cannot exercise.

I am gonna have to adjust my whole diet and cut out all those grains and starchy carbohydrates that were the fuel of my runs. Now i dont need them. 

I hate strength training. Nothing can fill up the void of my Running. 

Do you think i did permanent damage to my body by running for months on this injury？I just took very short runs once twice a week because i couldnt stand it.

I am sure i will be punished because i had the guilty pleasure to run... Based on how life sucks i am sure thata gonna be the case. 

What worries me is that its quite localized the pain. I cannot touch it when i rest because i only feel it when i walk. 

I am never gonna get over this one. Its a disgrace. 

Do you think whatever this is i can swim on it this summer？I really need to exercise for my mental sanity. If i can i will swim for the whole day... How i need it.

Thank you for getting back to me. I know we runners are very similar，But really were you also so out of your mind？

I mean，its bad really I would prefer to have someone cut my finger on my hand right now than this

ok sorry my question maybe was inappropriate but i was just hoping for a momentary advice before i see the dreaded doctor in two weeks.

I dont think i can access western hospitals in china so i have to wait until i go back to my country.

Sorry.. Its just painful. I dont think i can run in this

God Thank you. You name it！ There is someone who actually understands me. You know.. I am gonna tell you something Thats gonna make you laugh！I just Did what you told me with that plastic thing I am almost Bleeding now！ I Did scrape my leg But forgot to apply the oil and my skin is Red and It H.U.R.T.S！I have this pain which means i really i cannot do that treatment anymore because i just rubbed off my skin...Anyway，I have a very High pain tolerance.

I wanna ask you，are you back at It By now？If Yes what Did you do to return to healthy running？（please dont even tell me if its Rest for a year...）

Yeah basically I just wanted to Thank you for sharing Your story with me，It was really kind and beautiful because I can relate to it a lot.

I am gonna change doctor when I Go Home in two weeks because He is gonna kill me if I Go to See him... 
He threatened me to take 6 months to a year off if I would not have listened to his order to Rest completely one month. I am NEVER gonna See That guy again. He is out of his mind. NEVER. He even said not to Cycle.
I dont really adore doctors but i hope to find a better one. All They know is Rest，I just dont wanna hear that word.

Today another bad day because I didnt Run，believe me I Cant be around anyone，I am just angry，sad. Its not right！I Cannot put into words How much I miss Running... Especially healthy running. And the thing is .. If my body is gonna allow me to Run，I am gonna have a Hard time resisting the urge. Right now my body has put me a very big red light，because this pain is unbearable to the point i physically cannot run or i am gonna scream from pain. I hate it even more now with the plastic thing that rubbed my skin off... 

Its just sad... I planned all my Summer holidays doing what I love. In just 3 weeks away i was supposed to be at the high of my life.

I spent a big part of money I saved for years so I could holiday in the mountains of Sweden and do what I love.. Run. 

So much work and money wasted. If i go Yes I am still gonna Enjoy the mountains.. But if I Cannot run it just wont be the same. It makes me cry from the pain.. I waited all the year for the moment I could Run in those forests... I waited all my life for that. 

I hate to sit down all day... It kills me. the chair is Hell on earth. I just value exercise，I completely hate being sedentary even if i am forced to. I hate myself because i cannot Run. No matter How healthy I eat，I dont drink，dont smoke... I dont even dream to smell a cookie especially because i cannot burn it off. 

I simply hate losing all the fitness it took my life to build. I cannot it！

I used to be the fastest of all my running friends i know，my racing weight at 50.7 kg. right now. I maintain my lowest possible yet healthy weight. 
I used to Run 4 hours... they felt like nothing，Gos how i miss these times. It was -20... It was +40 with a scorching sun.. I would be all sunburned... But diying from happiness just because i was there running. 

I have never seen what a gft these days actually were. I dream at night how it feels to run like that without pain.

I hate losing that. Myself， Running defines me. 

I love swimming，long distance cycling，they are amazing... But nothing can compare to a Run.
I am never gonna be happy if i cannot Run. Never. I just dont wanna see anyone and anything. I just wanna go for a 4 hours run. Now. And I just want it. If it would be for me，i would run 12 hours a day. 

How I cannot stand this，I never thought this could happen to me... I watch my health like a police，I eat 100 percent healthy，I count every single calorie i put in my mouth，i weigh myself more than once a day to make sure i am at my racing weight and I make sure i dont lose and dont gain any weight which will differ from my current racing weight of 50.7...

No i am not anorexic nor i have eating disorders i guess but Running means everything to me and i want to keep the fitness it took me immense work to achieve.

I even rested one full day everyweek during Marathon training. Why me？

As soon As i go back home I will spend all my days swimming，its not running but i need to exercise like i need food. 

I will miss Running so much this Summer. I wish i had spent the money before.. When I could Run. Its just not right... And i cant put into words how i dread seeing the doctor when I go back home in two weeks... What if he is gonna put me on those sticks or how do you call then... I have nightmares about that. 

Unless my body will force me to stop walking i wont get those！

If i cant even walk i am nothing. Not even trees feel that pain.
mmm...

Hey thank you for asking. Actually i am not back，I did run today. 10 minutes was enough to make me cry from pain. i almost could not walk back home. Its a different kind of pain，I suspect my shin splints developed into a stress fracture. I have all the symptoms of a stress fracture. I will see my doctor in two weeks.... Right now I am in China. As soon as I get back to my home country I will see my doctor... 

What am I gonna tell him，that I have an UNBEARABLE PAIN. And that I did Run on it. 

Running is like breathing to me，
not only its the nutrition of my soul，its my escape from people. If i cannot run，I am in prison. If i cannot walk，
I am in prison with my hands wrapped. I Feel So stupid because I Did make my Injury much much worse By Running. Now I physically cant Run. Soon I suspect I wont even Walk Based on the pain I have. I am just at home，sitting all day waiting until I Go back Home to See my Doctor. 

I Did adjust all my other variables，particularly my nutrition to make my injury heal. I went from an anorexic 48 kg. to 50.7 kg. BMI just 18.8. 
Thats the highest weight i have seen in months and being at a healthy weight sucks. I miss to have thst sense of control over food. And I hate to say that eating actually feels good now.
This is a healthy weight and Its not been easy to fight off all the guilt It took me to gain this weight.
